title: GrantThai route sub-profile (routes/<route>/sub_profiles/<id>.yaml)
description: Draft 0.1.0. A named variant of one route's output, e.g. academic-article/thai-journal or academic-article/international-journal. A sub-profile is descriptive, not a venue registry: GrantThai holds NO fact about any journal, publisher or funder as its own. Every requirement item is NEEDS_VERIFICATION and either carries a source the researcher supplied (source_id resolving in the work object's sources) or is marked proposed_default. The NRIIS route keeps its own form profiles (spec/mappings/form_profile.schema.json); this schema is for routes added in v0.3+.

status.description: Always. A sub-profile describes a venue TYPE from GrantThai's side; a named venue's current author guidelines are the researcher's to confirm.

languages.description: Which language slots the sub-profile enables for title, abstract and keywords (drives ART001; bilingual defaults for a Thai journal are NEEDS_VERIFICATION).

basis.description: proposed_default: GrantThai's own placeholder, overridden by any VENUE.stated_requirements item that has a source_id. researcher_supplied_source: cite the source in `source`.

source.description: Required when basis is researcher_supplied_source: the document, edition and page, as the researcher supplied it.

notes.description: Plain statements of what this sub-profile does NOT know (scope, indexing, fees, review time, word limits are all NEEDS_VERIFICATION unless the researcher supplies the venue's document).
